translation_snapshot.source:
Activate some of your inner magic, using it to power your abilities.  For the next %d turns all active talents will be used without resource cost.
		Your resources must still be high enough to initially power the talent and failure rates (etc.) still apply.
translation_snapshot.target:
激活你的一部分内在魔力，用它来驱动你的能力。
		在接下来 %d 回合中，所有主动技能的使用都不消耗资源。
		你的资源仍须足以启动技能，失败率等仍照常生效。

translation_snapshot.source: The target is using talents without consuming resources.
translation_snapshot.target: 目标使用技能时不消耗资源。
